title: Loading list
description: A checklist showing the steps of a running task. Each spinner turns into a tick or a cross when its step finishes.
pageTitle: Step-by-Step Loading Checklist with Status Icons | Lordicon

whenToUse.text: Use it for processes with several steps: account setup, file processing, deployments or AI generation. People see what's happening now, what's done and exactly which step failed. A Retry button appears only when something goes wrong.
whenToUse.alt: Animated loading checklist: spinners turn into a tick or a cross as each task step finishes

accessibility: Steps are an ordered list, so screen readers announce order and count.
A polite live region announces each change: "In progress", "Done" or "Failed".
Status is shown by icon and color, and screen readers get it as text.
iconsNote: The check and cross animations are pretty special, but the loading icon is up to you. Swap it for another one from the library to give the list your own look.
